row.rationale_en: Qwen3.6-27B/RTX 4090/PCIe 4x8 at batch 1 reduces decode-step time from 2832 to 508 ms. The 34.23 to 3.78 GB/token result measures weight transfer, not resident memory. Its roughly 10% WikiText-2 PPL tolerance does not establish below-1% business quality loss and does not generalize to HBM-resident LLMs or domain models. TopK-Guided is a separate activation-budget mechanism not re-reviewed experiment by experiment in this revision. The performance and quality tables use unaligned read budgets and cannot establish joint gains at one configuration.
row.rationale_zh: Qwen3.6-27B/RTX4090/PCIe 4×8、batch 1的decode步时2832→508 ms，34.23→3.78 GB/token是权重搬运量，不是驻留显存。该工作允许WikiText-2 PPL约10%退化，未证明业务<1%质量损失；不能推广到HBM常驻LLM或领域模型。TopK-Guided是另一种激活预算机制，本轮未做逐实验复核。 性能表与质量表的读取预算未对齐，二者不能视作同配置联合收益。
row.recommendation_en: First confirm that the workload actually needs CPU offload; skip full SpAx migration for HBM-resident weights. For offload, hold model, link, batch and quality threshold fixed, compare full reads with activation-guided tiered reads, and measure physical traffic, selection overhead, decode-step time and service TPOT. Increase read budgets when quality fails rather than using the paper PPL allowance as business acceptance.
row.recommendation_zh: 先确认业务是否真的需要CPU卸载；若权重已常驻HBM，不安排SpAx整模型移植。卸载场景保持相同模型、链路、batch和质量阈值，比较完整读取与按激活重要性分级读取，记录真实搬运量、选择开销、decode步时及服务TPOT。质量超门槛时放宽读取预算，不能只用PPL上限替代业务验收。
row.title_en: SpAx: test tiered reads only for CPU-offloaded weight bottlenecks
row.title_zh: SpAx：只在CPU卸载搬运受限时验证分级权重读取

row.rationale_en: Page-EntroKV physical-budget UOR 4.75 to 1.00 is pilot/replay evidence; needle-page retention is not answer accuracy and serving TTFT/TPOT are unreported. DeferKV Qwen3-8B LongBench at budget 512 scores 48.37 versus FullKV 49.77, about 2.81% relative loss, exceeding the below-1% quality gate. Total time cannot substitute for TTFT/TPOT. This route therefore remains on watch.
row.rationale_zh: Page-EntroKV的物理预算UOR 4.75→1.00属于pilot/回放；needle页保留率不是问答精度，未报告服务TTFT/TPOT。DeferKV在Qwen3-8B LongBench、512预算下为48.37，FullKV为49.77（相对下降约2.81%），不满足<1%质量门槛；总时延不能代替TTFT/TPOT。现有证据不足以把本路线整体列为优先。
row.recommendation_en: Only when physical pages limit long-context serving, validate Page-EntroKV reclamation against no eviction and simple-budget baselines, then separately ablate DeferKV first-decode-step decisions. Do not combine claimed gains. Relax the budget if per-task quality fails; fix page management if quality holds but occupancy does not fall; stop when scoring or reclamation costs exceed the savings.
row.recommendation_zh: 仅在长上下文物理页确为瓶颈时，先以不淘汰与简单预算为基线验证Page-EntroKV的真实页回收，再单独消融DeferKV的首步延迟决策；不组合论文收益。逐任务质量不达标时先放宽预算；质量达标但页占用不降时修页管理，评分/回收开销高于节省时停止。
row.title_en: KV eviction: establish quality and serving evidence before migration
row.title_zh: KV淘汰：先补齐质量与服务证据，再安排移植

row.rationale_en: AttSVD reduces Qwen3-8B 32k KV tensors from 4.50 to 2.26 GiB while the nine-task LongBench average stays at 51.8; TTFT and TPOT are unreported. This supports capacity research, not proven acceleration. SAGA changes head layout and uses distillation: its v1 Qwen2.5-1.5B HellaSwag score falls from 67.8 to 64.4, so it does not share AttSVD conditional priority. The existing website SAGA v2 entry does not replace this report v1 review.
row.rationale_zh: AttSVD在Qwen3-8B/32k、rank64的存储核算中将KV张量4.50压至2.26 GiB；另在50% KV预算的LongBench九任务实验中均分51.8→51.8；未报告TTFT/TPOT。该证据支持研究缓存容量，不证明推理加速。SAGA涉及头布局和蒸馏，v1的Qwen2.5-1.5B HellaSwag 67.8→64.4，不能与AttSVD共享“条件优先”的结论；网页既有SAGA v2入口也不替代本报告v1复核。
row.recommendation_en: On real long-context LLM requests, compare uncompressed KV, plain SVD, attention-weighted SVD and dynamic K/V ranks, separating Accum exact tails from Stream block compression. Include online SVD in TTFT, reconstruction and later compression in TPOT, and factors, tails and temporary buffers in peak memory. Proceed only when each key task loses less than 1% and concurrency increases under the same service latency gate. Do not apply this experiment to domain models without autoregressive KV.
row.recommendation_zh: 在真实长文本LLM请求中比较未压缩KV、普通SVD、注意力加权SVD与动态K/V选秩；分别评估Accum精确尾部和Stream分块压缩。把在线SVD计入TTFT、重建与后续压缩计入TPOT，并测因子、尾部和临时缓冲峰值。关键任务损失<1%且同服务时延门槛下并发增加才推进；不对没有自回归KV的领域模型安排此实验。
row.title_en: AttSVD: validate low-rank KV capacity gains

row.rationale_en: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 four-task long-reasoning average falls from 67.18 to 60.55, about 9.87% relatively, while TTFT rises 10–14%. Throughput of 220.8 to 412.6 tok/s uses maximum batches 6 and 84 rather than matched-batch speedup; TPOT is not reported separately. Calculated byte savings in quantized regions are not request peak memory and do not establish high throughput, low latency and below-1% quality loss together.
row.rationale_zh: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507四项长推理均分67.18→60.55（相对下降约9.87%），TTFT增加10%–14%。220.8→412.6 tok/s来自最大batch 6→84，不是同batch加速；未单独报告TPOT。低位宽区域的理论字节节省不能替代整个请求的峰值显存，也不足以证明高吞吐、低时延与<1%质量同时成立。
row.recommendation_en: Retain research on query-sensitive weighting, cross-head normalization and covariance grouping, but defer the paper 1-bit configuration. Start any follow-up with quality sweeps against a higher-bit KV baseline supported by the target stack, then test serving only after each key task meets the below-1% gate. Report fixed-batch latency separately from maximum concurrency at equal memory and do not hide TTFT regressions behind capacity throughput.
row.recommendation_zh: 保留查询敏感加权、跨头归一化与协方差分组的机制研究，暂不移植论文1-bit配置。若后续研究，先用目标栈已支持的较高位宽KV基线做质量扫描，达到逐任务<1%后再测试服务性能；分开报告固定batch时延和相同显存预算下的最大并发，禁止以容量吞吐掩盖TTFT退化。
row.title_en: TaSQ: current 1-bit quality and first-token costs miss the target
row.title_zh: TaSQ：1-bit质量损失与首字开销尚不适合当前目标

row.rationale_en: On Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct/A100, batch 1 and 128/512 input/output tokens, TPOT falls from 17.19 to 7.54 ms and resident GPU memory from 5.99 to 2.72 GiB, while TTFT rises from 17.47 to 19.67 ms. MMLU changes from 60.66 to 60.53, but HellaSwag loses about 1.09% relatively, so the business quality gate below 1% is not established. The transferable mechanism aligns precision assignment, packing and execution blocks; OSFP4 remains separate format context.
row.rationale_zh: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct在A100、batch 1、输入128/输出512 tokens下，TPOT由17.19降至7.54 ms，驻留显存5.99降至2.72 GiB；TTFT却由17.47升至19.67 ms。MMLU 60.66→60.53，但HellaSwag相对下降约1.09%，不能据此认定满足业务<1%门槛。可迁移的核心是精度分配、打包和执行块对齐；OSFP4继续作为独立格式背景，不与AlignQuant拼成收益。
row.recommendation_en: For an LLM such as Qwen3.8-27B, hold activation treatment fixed and compare executable W8, W4 and block-level W4/W8. Reproduce joint prefill/decode sensitivity, then map blocks to legal matrix-kernel tiles. Check each quality task and TTFT, steady-state TPOT, throughput and resident/peak memory. Stop full migration if mixed kernels are unsupported or unpacking cancels gains. Validate 310P and 910B separately; evaluate 950 only after its model and software stack are confirmed.
row.recommendation_zh: 以LLM（如Qwen3.8-27B）为例，固定激活方案，比较可执行的W8、W4与块级W4/W8；先复现prefill/decode联合敏感度选位，再匹配目标矩阵核合法tile。质量逐任务验收，同时测TTFT、稳态TPOT、吞吐及驻留/峰值显存。若混合核不支持或解包抵消收益，暂停完整移植。310P/910B分别验证；950型号与软件栈确认后再评估。
row.title_zh: AlignQuant：验证块对齐的混合精度执行

row.rationale_en: For Qwen3-8B, two-stage rank-64 compensation improves QuIP# 3-bit CSQA from 68.10 to 69.11 versus FP16 69.38, a 0.27-point or 0.39% relative loss; compensated 2-bit reaches only 64.51. TTFT/TPOT are unreported and rank-64 adapters add 264–349 MB across models. StagQ at 2 bits and DBW at 1.61 bits retain substantial quality losses, so only Align Then Correct receives conditional priority within this route.
row.rationale_zh: Qwen3-8B的QuIP# 3-bit加两阶段rank64补偿后，CSQA由68.10升至69.11，FP16为69.38（低0.27个百分点、相对低0.39%）；2-bit补偿后仅64.51。TTFT/TPOT未报告，rank64适配器跨模型增加264–349 MB。StagQ 2-bit和DBW 1.61-bit仍有明显质量损失，因此本路线仅将Align Then Correct列为条件优先，不把极低位宽整体列为优先。
row.recommendation_en: Choose an already quantized LLM failing quality checks, freeze the same quantized weights, and compare no compensation, one-stage alignment and two-stage rank-64 correction. Study the 3-bit mechanism, but deploy only formats supported by the target stack. Measure task-specific recovery and net benefits after adapter bytes, low-rank GEMMs, fusion and intermediate tensors. Domain models may separately test linear-layer compensation using their own denoising or translation metrics, not extrapolated CSQA.
row.recommendation_zh: 选择已量化但质量未达标的LLM，冻结同一份量化权重，比较无补偿、单阶段对齐及两阶段rank64补偿；先研究3-bit机制，部署只用目标栈已支持的格式。测恢复的具体任务，并将适配器字节、低秩GEMM、融合与中间张量计入净收益。领域模型可独立评估线性层误差补偿，但必须使用降噪/翻译任务自身指标，不外推CSQA。
row.title_en: Align Then Correct: validate net gains from quantization-error compensation
row.title_zh: Align Then Correct：验证量化误差补偿的净收益
